name: Hotel Locarno
summary: A true-luxury pick: the hotel calls itself a five-star, opened in 1925, on Via della Penna.
description: Hotel Locarno is Lina’s true-luxury pick in Rome, not a bargain dressed up as one. The hotel says it opened in 1925, files itself as a five-star, and keeps the address at Via della Penna 22, just off Piazza del Popolo. People come for the history and the roof, not for a loophole in the rate. We have not checked a current price and we will not invent one. Use the button and read Booking.com.
